main_body: A dead/weeping willow-like tree with a drooping dark brown canopy of hanging branches and a short flared trunk
top_band: none - the canopy is a mass of drooping dark brown strands; no distinct lighter horizontal top surface above a front face
evidence: The column scan at x=20 shows only alternating dark (L=18) and mid-dark (L=42) brown runs with 1-row L=74 branch highlights, then a trunk. There is no lighter top band separated by a step from a front face. This is an organic canopy and trunk drawn as a frontal silhouette, with no horizontal top surface. The canopy is not a lighter mass seen from above. The drooping strands read as vertical, so a clear top is not shown. By the strict standard, with no top band, this fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. All of its dark edge pixels are neutral (100%), so the outline is near-black rather than a tinted material tone. Its ramp is three brown steps (near-black, dark brown, mid brown) plus a few highlight pixels, which is much shallower than the 5-6 green steps of the references. The canopy is a dark mass of drooping strands with little leaf clumping or per-clump shading. It would look much thinner and flatter than either reference.
